techniques.why: Each implementation wave consumes validated evidence from the prior wave.
The first unit compiles only the initial eligible action set.
Every layer proves how its unit reconnects to the single-entry native canary.
Validation, execution, task, and human authorities remain distinct.
Every task and native role must return a structured receipt.
Deterministic fixtures precede causal native canaries and closeout.
All action and receipt evidence is grouped by dispatch and run identifiers.
Completion claims must point to run-local artifacts, not generic narratives.
Machine contract invariants are mapped into SWU acceptance evidence.
Deferred cross-host parity and migration work retain explicit owners.
